name: doc-header
description: Inline article header for product-documentation surfaces: breadcrumb, article <h1>, optional lede standfirst, last-edited date with history link, auth-gated edit/view-source row. No background fill — part of the text flow, not a banner.
html:
1. Home
  2. {{category-name}}
  3. {{article-title}}

{{article-title}}

Updated {{display-date}}
Edit this page · View source

variants.name: standard
variants.description: Breadcrumb + h1 + meta row + auth-gated edit row.

variants.name: with-lede
variants.description: Adds a promoted standfirst paragraph between titlewrap and meta — render when frontmatter declares content_type: guide or content_type: research.

aria: Breadcrumb is <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> wrapping an <ol>, aria-current='page' on the final <li>. One <h1 class='article__title'> per page. Last-edited date uses machine-readable <time datetime>. The edit/view-source row is removed from the accessibility tree entirely for anonymous sessions (display: none on html[data-auth='anon']), not just visually hidden.
